offering_description.value: Produces credit, debit and prepaid payment cards, including metal, contactless and EMV chip cards, for banks, card issuers and fintechs. Also provides card personalization, instant issuance systems, fulfillment and digital issuance solutions. Manufactures in secure production facilities in the US and abroad.

primary_products.value: EMV chip payment cards; contactless cards; metal payment cards; prepaid card packaging; instant issuance printers and software

primary_services.value: card personalization; card fulfillment and mailing; instant issuance support; digital card provisioning

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, credit unions, card issuers, fintechs, prepaid program managers, card processors and retailers

end_markets.value: banking and financial services; payments; prepaid cards; fintech; retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: payment cards and prepaid packaging sold to issuers; service fees: card personalization, fulfillment and instant issuance services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes cards from purchased plastics, chips and metal, sold to issuers and program managers; service provider: personalizes and fulfills cards for issuers

geography_served.value: global: United States primarily, plus Canada, Europe, Latin America and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: debit and credit cards, prepaid packaging, card personalization and instant issuance solutions

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to issuers, processors and program managers; partners / resellers: resellers of instant issuance solutions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payment card security certifications from Visa, Mastercard and other networks, PCI standards, data privacy rules
